bio.text: Corley Ellis, a Republican, has represented District 41 in the Alabama House of Representatives since taking office on October 20, 2016, and is on the November 3, 2026 general election ballot for re-election.
Ellis earned a B.S. in business administration from Auburn University in 1993 and an M.B.A. in 1995, and his professional experience includes owning and operating Ellis Properties Inc.
